capability_chain: ScreenSession stores the exported IRemoteObject in renderSession_.
RSRenderPipelineClient treats it as RSIConnectToRenderProcess, descriptor ohos.rosen.ConnectToRenderProcess.
RSRenderServiceConnectHub::GetRenderProcessTokenMaskId creates a local empty RSIConnectionToken and calls CreateRenderConnection(tokenMaskId, token, needRefresh).
Subsequent RSRenderInterface/RSUIContext operations route through that client-to-render connection.

access_verifier.capture_exception: OnRemoteRequest lets TAKE_SURFACE_CAPTURE and TAKE_SURFACE_CAPTURE_WITH_ALL_WINDOWS proceed when generic accessibility is false, but records screenCapturePermission=false and computes system/self-capture flags in the handler.

confidentiality.basis: GetBitmap, GetPixelmap and capture methods expose pixel-producing capabilities; self/PID and CAPTURE_SCREEN checks bound some paths.
confidentiality.missing: runtime proof that a non-privileged caller can enumerate target node IDs and retrieve target pixels

integrity.basis: CommitTransaction and node creation have no explicit system-case in the inspected verifier and can submit render commands to the acquired connection.
integrity.missing: runtime proof that the acquired connection is scoped to another screen/render process and that commands change target state

availability.basis: transaction submission, synchronous tasks, node creation and RemoveConnection/RemoveToken are potential resource/lifecycle controls.
availability.missing: measured crash, hang, resource exhaustion or service denial

conclusion: The exported object is not merely opaque in its downstream use: its concrete entry interface is RSIConnectToRenderProcess and it creates RSIClientToRenderConnection, a broad render command/pixel/lifecycle surface. Static evidence supports C/I candidate consequences and possible A impact, but exact candidate product execution and cross-screen scoping remain unproven; CAP-01 remains candidate/unknown.
